# Artemis Leonardou

> Full stack engineer, DevRel, and tech content creator based in Athens. Building products and teaching people to build with AI.

Artemis Leonardou (known online as Artemis Codes, @artemis.codes) is a 19-year-old engineer and content creator. She is a Software Engineer and DevRel at NOFire AI, a UGC Creator at Lovable, and an Informatics student at NKUA (Top 1%). Her main Instagram (@artemis.codes) has 300k+ monthly views and 6.7k followers, growing rapidly.

## What she does

- **Builds**: Full stack web applications, AI-integrated products, mobile apps (Python/Django, Next.js, React Native)
- **Creates**: Short-form tech content on TikTok and Instagram covering AI tools, vibe coding, and practical AI builder tutorials
- **DevRel**: Site Reliability Engineering and Developer Relations at NOFire AI
